# TOWR.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp728.0 against Rp370.0 (expected total return 100.8%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: infra_tower_compounder · method card: per fund record routing for Telecom towers & fibre.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The WACC uses a 9.45% pre-tax cost of debt (rf 7.45% plus a 2.00pp deck corporate spread), but the LK discloses 2026 borrowing rates of 4.65-8.69% rupiah, 4.58-7.10% USD, 5.30-5.70% JPY and 4.10-4.40% CNH [S4], and the m
- §4 says 'the peer EV/EBITDA median of 6.0x would value the shares far above the DCF'. 6.0x is mult.FY2026E.ev_ebitda, TOWR's OWN FY2026E multiple; the model's peer median is 14.53x (BALI 14.5x, CENT 37.6x, TBIG 11.7x) — 
- The towers method card's first test — AFFO yield must clear the 10y FR with a spread for leverage — is never computed. On the draft's own numbers (FY2026E EBITDA 10,942, maintenance capex ~D&A 3,254, cash interest 2,786,

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
